patterns.message: Import only from the UI component barrel (@/shared/ui/X). Deep imports into component internals are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import only from the lib topic barrel (@/shared/libs/X). Deep imports into lib internals are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import hooks from the barrel: @/shared/hooks. Direct imports from individual hook files are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import utils from the barrel: @/shared/utils. Direct imports from individual util files are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import config from the barrel: @/shared/config. Direct imports from individual config files are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import types from the barrel: @/shared/types. Direct imports from individual type files are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
Import only from the module's public barrel (@/modules/X). Deep imports into module internals, including component subfolders, are forbidden. If the export you need is not in index.ts, add it there.
